title: January 23 Helsinki Navalny solidarity demonstrations
notes: Demand concerns release of Alexei Navalny by Russian authorities. No own-Finnish-state demand established. Sixteen advance notices, permitted ten-person groups and a staggered window are not simultaneous actual attendance.

title: Suomen Kotidata private employer strike notices
notes: January 14 union statement announces January 28–February 24 work stoppage and references prior stoppage until January 24. No demonstrated >=50 public physical gathering or Finnish state-policy demand. Planned strike boundaries are not physical event dates.

title: Kansalaistori New Year party
notes: Aligned calendar describes December 31 party 23:00–01:00 with music/dancing and amplifier confiscation. Crossing midnight is not evidence of a qualifying January protest onset or demand. No demonstrated crowd threshold.

title: January 31 Helsinki Navalny solidarity lead
notes: Associated outlet retrospectively mentions small Navalny gatherings as a comparison with January 30. Foreign Russian state target excludes it from this extension; physical details/size remain incompletely verified and are not promoted to a qualifying candidate.

title: February 14 Helsinki Covid restriction demonstrations
notes: Body and publication metadata identify a separate February 14 action. Twelve notices and ten-person limit are not an exact actual crowd count. Not a continuation from January 30 after attributed closure.

title: March 27 Turku Covid restriction protest
notes: Contemporary body identifies about 150 at Turku Cathedral on March 27 and later departure order/arrests. March reporting must not be assigned to January by search discovery date.

title: Reported individual assault on Juha Sipilä outside Parliament
notes: January 13 body describes an alleged assault by an unknown individual while Sipilä crossed a road on January 7; early motive unknown. No public mass protest or >=50 gathering established.

title: Valkom residents protest Lovisa harbor and chemical terminal planning
notes: Resolved through topic-index article link. Body describes about 30 people demonstrating on April 28 against municipal harbor planning, below 50 and outside January. No crowd inferred from photographs.
